title: A.I. Helps Find Major Security Bug in Java, a Software Platform Vital to the Internet
summary: The discovery by security company Calif shows A.I.’s ability to find gaping security holes in popular software. The Java flaw pointed to vulnerabilities in systems used by nearly all Fortune 500 companies.
